propositions: Operators require a reproducible report that separates Git pack bytes from checkout residence and filesystem block slack for accurate footprint measurement.
A fresh-clone mode must measure a temporary unfiltered single-branch clone with local hardlink optimization disabled to establish standalone clone baseline.
Footprint reporting must be read-only, opt-in, and never run from ticket writes, reconciliation, gates, or automated workflows.
The report must separate packed object bytes, checkout logical bytes, checkout allocated bytes (when st_blocks available), file count, Git-directory logical/allocated bytes, and whole-clone totals.
Platform-specific allocation accounting (st_blocks) must be reported as structured unavailable values rather than fabricated zeros when unsupported.
Measurement results must never determine exit status, apply thresholds, establish baselines, or block unrelated work.
